label: Thermal acceleration
subgoals: Multiply the activation energy over k by the difference of reciprocal temperatures
Exponentiate to get the acceleration factor

label: Voltage acceleration
subgoals: Take the difference between stress and use voltage
Multiply by the voltage acceleration constant
Exponentiate to get the voltage acceleration factor

label: Lifetime at use conditions
subgoals: Compute the thermal and voltage acceleration factors
Multiply the stress time by both factors
Convert hours to years for the use-condition lifetime
